partners.mechanism_chain: FAM20A (HGNC:29038) —DISRUPTS→ extracellular matrix mineralization (GO:0001502); extracellular matrix mineralization (GO:0001502) —LEADS_TO→ Amelogenesis imperfecta (HP:0001248); APOA1 (HGNC:598) —DISRUPTS→ cholesterol metabolism (GO:0008203); cholesterol metabolism (GO:0008203) —DECREASES→ HDL cholesterol (CHEBI:57979); HDL cholesterol (CHEBI:57979) —LEADS_TO→ Hypoalphalipoproteinemia (HP:0003134).
